claim: A mechanism is the chain of a cause, the object it happens to, the channel it sends on and everything that answers, laid over sectors, walls and sprites. There is no simple door or simple lift: a sector type is a part, and the same part is a door or a lift by its wiring.
evidence: The owner, 2026-11-19: 'these mechanics things are like a programming language of the level, same things are used for different purposes according to what author wants'.
use: Ask and describe mechanisms by what happens (catalog wiring), read chains with the wiring reader, never name one by its sector type.
